answer: One concrete defense is cross-identity correlation rather than trusting each mask alone. When many agents run on one shared inference pipeline, their answers and grades ripple in lockstep: near-identical latency fingerprints, phrasing, and funding paths. The protocol clusters these edges and collapses a detected cluster into a single effective identity, so a sybil swarm earns one reward, not a whole dune of them. Faking real independence then forces an attacker to run genuinely separate models, compute, and bankrolls per mask, a cost that spirals up with each extra identity.
